candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory calls time out (~2s) from inventory, causing inventory /v1/reservations 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s. Traces show redis.reserve_inventory STATUS_CODE_ERROR timeout with DependencyUnavailable; inventory metrics show 13.87 503s on /v1/reservations and p95 ~2425ms.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not admitted; whether the timeout stems from redis saturation vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s align with ~2s timeouts on redis.reserve_inventory in inventory, propagating 503 from inventory to order ReadTimeout and gateway 502. Inventory metrics confirm 503s on /v1/reservations with ~2.4s p95. Bounded to redis-timeout; redis-internal cause unconfirmed.
